name: MonarchAiInsightCallout
title: AiInsightCallout
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row and FlowRow with background, drawBehind and border, MonarchCollapsible, MonarchButton, androidx.compose.material3.IconButton
summary: A proactive insight about the current record or screen: what was noticed, why, the evidence and one action, with its origin shown honestly as "AI insight" or "Rule-based".
whenToUse: On a record or dashboard, to raise one thing the person should know or act on, such as a renewal at risk, with the reason and where it came from.
whenNotToUse: For several insights side by side use MonarchInsightStrip. For a system message that is not an insight use MonarchInlineNotice or MonarchBanner. For an error in an assistant reply use MonarchAiErrorMessage.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiInsightCallout(title: String, why: String, origin: MonarchAiInsightOrigin, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Info, heading: Boolean = false, actionLabel: String? = null, onAction: (() -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, originIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, dismissIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiInsightCalloutLabels = MonarchAiInsightCalloutLabels(), evidence: (@Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
data class MonarchAiInsightCalloutLabels(tone: String? = null, ai: String? = null, rule: String? = null, evidence: String? = null, dismiss: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The insight in one line, already localised, such as "Renewal at risk".

options.name: why
options.description: Why it was raised, in plain words. Shown as plain text.

options.name: origin
options.description: Ai: produced by a model, labelled "AI insight" in the assistant colors. Rule: a fixed rule written by people, labelled "Rule-based" in neutral colors. Always shown.

options.name: tone
options.description: How much it matters: Info, Warning, Danger (needs action now), Success (good news) or Neutral. Sets the fill, border, bar and icon color and the tone name read before the title.

options.name: heading
options.description: Marks the title as a heading for TalkBack navigation.

options.name: actionLabel
options.description: The label of the one follow-up action, a small MonarchButton. Shown only together with onAction.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Adds a dismiss button at the end. The app removes the callout and decides where focus goes.

options.name: icon
options.description: The tone icon at the start, tinted with the tone's strong color. Decorative.

options.name: originIcon
options.description: A mark before the origin label, such as a bot icon for the AI origin. Decorative.

options.name: dismissIcon
options.description: The close mark of the dismiss button. Without it the button shows "Dismiss insight" as text.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces the built-in strings: the tone name, "AI insight", "Rule-based", "Show evidence" and "Dismiss insight".

options.name: evidence
options.description: Supporting data, shown in a collapsed "Show evidence" disclosure.

states.name: tone
states.description: Each tone uses its subtle fill, its border and its strong color for the start bar and the icon.

states.name: evidence collapsed
states.description: Only the "Show evidence" row is shown; it reads as collapsed.

states.name: evidence expanded
states.description: The evidence is shown under the disclosure row, animated only when animations are on.

states.name: dismissible
states.description: With onDismiss, a dismiss button sits at the end; the callout stays until the app removes it.

appearance: A container with the large radius, the tone's subtle fill and border and a four-dp bar in the tone's strong color on the start edge. The title uses the strong body type, the reason the body type in the default text color. The origin label is a pill: the subtle assistant fill, assistant border and strong assistant text for AI, the surface fill, default border and muted text for rule-based. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Same parts as the web and iOS. The web's severity names (info, warning, critical, positive) map to MonarchTone Info, Warning, Danger and Success, and the spoken tone names keep the web words (Info, Warning, Critical, Positive). Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the tone icon, the origin mark and the close mark are optional slots; without a close mark the dismiss button shows its label. The web renders the title as a heading of a chosen level; Android has one heading level, set with heading. The evidence disclosure keeps its open state across configuration changes.
accessibility: TalkBack reads the title with the tone name first, for example "Warning: Renewal at risk", so the tone is never color alone; the neutral tone, or an empty tone label, reads the title alone.
With heading true the title is a heading.
The origin label is visible text, "AI insight" or "Rule-based", and is read as such.
The evidence disclosure is a button with the expand and collapse actions and a collapsed or expanded state.
The action button, the disclosure row and the dismiss button each have a 48dp touch target; the dismiss button is named "Dismiss insight".
The icons are decorative and hidden from TalkBack.
The tone bar and the dismiss button follow the layout direction.
edgeCases: A long title wraps, and the origin label moves to the next line when it does not fit beside it.
actionLabel without onAction, or onAction without actionLabel, shows no action.
Without a dismiss icon the dismiss button is a text button and takes more width.

examples.template:
MonarchAiInsightCallout(
    title = {{title}},
    why = {{why}},
    origin = MonarchAiInsightOrigin.{{origin|pascal}},
    tone = {{severity|tone}},
    actionLabel = {{action.label}},
    onAction = {},
    onDismiss = {},
) {
    Text({{evidence.0}})
    Text({{evidence.1}})
}
examples.code:
MonarchAiInsightCallout(
    title = "Renewal at risk",
    why = "Weekly active users fell from 48 to 29 over the last 30 days.",
    origin = MonarchAiInsightOrigin.Ai,
    tone = MonarchTone.Warning,
    actionLabel = "Plan a check-in",
    onAction = {},
    onDismiss = {},
) {
    Text("Logins: 312 → 190 (30 days)")
    Text("Support tickets: 2 → 7 (30 days)")
}

examples.title: A rule-based insight
examples.code:
MonarchAiInsightCallout(
    title = "Invoice overdue",
    why = "Unpaid for 30 days.",
    origin = MonarchAiInsightOrigin.Rule,
    tone = MonarchTone.Danger,
)
